description: This file defines a Pinia store for managing weight entries in a Vue.js application. It includes state variables, asynchronous actions to fetch and add weight data, and imports various dependencies related to Vue and external services.

methods.name: fetchAll
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches all weight entries from the external API and updates the store state.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new weight entry by calling the external API and prepending the new entry to the local items array.
